title: Actual scalar tensor comparison on complexes and K-flat preservation
statement: Let R to S be a map of commutative ring sheaves on the given small site, and D its actual derived change-of-rings cochain model [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Ordinary extension induces a natural chain isomorphism E(P tensor_R Q) = E(P) tensor_S E(Q) [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], sending 1 tensor (x tensor y) to (1 tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y) on the specified sheafified generators. E sends every K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex] to a K-flat complex. No derived tensor comparison or Hom comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 06YT and 08J9; scalar extension on signed total tensor and K-flat preservation.

proof.text: Apply scalarInternalHomAdjunction_exists with standard derived-category choices at all coefficient rings. Only the ordinary extension, its normalized unit, the chain tensor components and K-flat preservation are retained. Identify the resulting extension functor with D.E using Functor.ext and their prescribed object and map equations. To establish naturality of the chain tensor components, transpose each degree along the ordinary scalar adjunction, and test the resulting map on every total pure tensor generator. The existing total_pure_hom_ext and tensor_generator_map helpers of ScalarHomTensorCoherence supply tensor extensionality and functoriality; unit naturality and the comparison generator formula make the two sides equal. NatIso.ofComponents assembles the natural chain isomorphism. Apply the normalized ordinaryUnit equation and cancel the object-equality isomorphism to identify scalarHomUnitSection with ringedFiniteFreeScalarSection at scalar 1. The comparison generator formula and preservesKFlat field give the two remaining clauses. Standard derived choices disappear from the conclusion.

    (D : SheafOfModules.DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel.{c, v, max c v r, w, w} φ) :
    ∃ (κ : WeilConjectures.coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R ⋙

        (D.E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).prod
          (D.E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙
            WeilConjectures.coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J S),
      (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) ℤ)
        (p q : ℤ) (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X p).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj U),
        ((κ.hom.app (P, Q)).f (p + q)).val.app U
          (ringedFiniteFreeScalarSection.{c, v, r} J φ D.E D.obj_eq
            (((WeilConjectures.coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).obj (P, Q)).X (p + q))
            U 1 (WeilConjectures.coefficientTensorGenerator.{r, c, v} J R
              P Q p q (p + q) rfl U x y)) =
        WeilConjectures.coefficientTensorGenerator.{r, c, v} J S
          ((D.E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
          ((D.E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q (p + q) rfl U
          (ringedFiniteFreeScalarSection.{c, v, r} J φ D.E D.obj_eq (P.X p) U 1 x)
          (ringedFiniteFreeScalarSection.{c, v, r} J φ D.E D.obj_eq (Q.X q) U 1 y)) ∧
      (∀ (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
        (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) ℤ),
        CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := R) P →
          CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := S)
            ((D.E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P))
